description: A board that an app script builds, with every id given, so that none is drawn at random. Its block classes are defined outside a package, so their registry ids are their names, and it holds no plugin, so the JSON board records no package. The UI of the join block ships the schema of its state. R writes that block's by, a vector of length one, as an array, and its all_x as a value, while it writes the state of the letters blocks bare. The stack of one block keeps its blocks an array, by the schema of a JSON board, and the value of show_conditions is an array, by the schema that core ships beside its runtime, recorded with the version of its shape, as each board option's value is. The stack has a color, a hex color that frontends draw it in. The block b holds a locked of false, which leaves it open under the board lock, while the blocks a and c hold null, which R writes for a lock of NA and which follows the board lock. The client opens the JSON board and saves it as it is.
